subject: R INLA crashes after OS update

messages.author: 10a9a7970eb46cba
messages.subject: R INLA crashes after OS update
parts:
Hi all,

I am a new R-INLA user. We're using the package for our habitat selection models, but I have yet to successfully run a call to inla. I was getting an error described most recently in this group by Jiaxiang Ji, where H. Rue said the solution was to update MacOS. 

Anyway, now I'm running the latest version of R on macOS Sonoma, and I installed the INLA package via GitHub. INLA still crashes, but the error output is slightly different. How can I prevent this error?

Thanks so much,

Miles Buddy

Call:
ord3.inla  <- inla(formula.ord3.inla, family ="binomial", data=ord3_rsfha, weights=ord3_rsfha$weight,
                   control.fixed = list(
                     mean = 0,
                     prec = list(hab = prec.beta.hab)
                   ),
                   control.compute=list(return.marginals.predictor=TRUE), verbose = TRUE
)

Error output:
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-arm64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac.arm64/inla.run: line 65: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-arm64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac.arm64/inla: No such file or directory
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-arm64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac.arm64/inla.run: line 71: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-arm64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac.arm64/inla: No such file or directory
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-arm64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac.arm64/inla.run: line 71: exec: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-arm64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac.arm64/inla: cannot execute: No such file or directory
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
